items.description: The Google Page Experience testing tool enables you to quickly audit a web page to test if it will pass this set of search signals: Core Web Vitals, Mobile friendly, Safe Browsing, HTTPS and No Intrusive interstitials.
TennisPoint Voiceblaster allows teams to communicate with their entire team at once using the phone. A player can record a message and it is sent out to the entire team instantly.
MailPeak uses the Twilio API to turn webmail accounts into voicemail. Listen and send voice replies to your emails from any phone.
Shows all the locations of a chosen physician group. Click on an icon to see a list of the physicians at that location.

This map shows all UK trains currently on approach to a particular station. Data is fetched from the National Rail website. The yellow pins are stations, the red pins trains. The trains move in approximately real time.
If you are interested in the game business, you can use the GCDB searching and mapping tools to find companies near you.

DJBooth connects to the Dada Search API to contextually integrate dynamic links to music content. When DJBooth passes an artist name to the Dada REST API, Dada returns artist-specific XML content in real-time.
shows ten tweets per friend in twitter
Browse the vineyards of Oregon via this comprehensive map. Search by location, varietal or vineyard amenity.

Attractions of America lists top 10 attractions in each of the 50 States of America. Destinations include top beaches, top museums, top nightlife places, and top romantic destinations. The site shows the categories of things to do, US map, deals, and photos. Attractions of America invites users to add a favorite attraction at no cost with the aim to increase the number of adventures presented on the site.

integrate The Raiser’s Edge, with your email marketing using the Springbaud email management solution, by Protégé Solutions. Once the Springbaud plug-in is installed, you can upload lists to Campaign Monitor and retrieve results from sent campaigns, all from within The Raiser’s Edge.
We have created a white label shopping price comparison platform using the PriceSpin XML API. Fully brandable and customisable to suit a client's look and feel.
A real estate website from Denmark that uses Google Maps for tracking the houses for sale or rent on the map.
Best movies in theaters, coming soon or on dvd. Search movies, find movie times for theaters.
Jozomello TV is a web page that serves Turkish,Kurdish,Arabic,Armenian and Persian music clips and videos. It uses YouTube API and selects videos order by popularity and view count.
Search for jobs by city name. Mashup of Indeed and Google Maps.
Dubtune uses YouTube, Soundcloud and Last.fm to create a Dubstep listening platform for fans of the genre. Soundcloud and Youtube are used as the basis for media streaming and Last.fm for meta data.

Web widgets that display Amazon items and earn referral revenue through Amazon Associates. Browser is an Amazon mini browser. List displays wish lists, baby and wedding registries, List Mania lists. Latest and Greatest shows bestsellers and new releases.
Real-time schedules and rider alerts from Metro Transit on iPhone, Android, and Windows Mobile devices
